summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new Immobilier (Real Estate) module on SB Drive VTC. All 8 user scenarios validated end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL (mobile container, 480px). Browse with Acheter/Louer toggle + category chips + debounced search filter; Publier flow creates a listing and redirects to Mes biens; PropertyDetailPage renders price/title and sticky contact bar; Inquiry modal (offer/message/phone) succeeds when sent from a different account (qatest_re@demo.sb created via /api/auth/register); MyPropertiesPage tabs work (Mes biens / Mes demandes (1)), Modifier prefilled + update works, Demandes expands inline inquiry list, Marquer vendu/loué updates status, Supprimer removes the listing. Admin panel /admin/real-estate renders Immobilier table with status filter chips (re-admin-filter-all/active/inactive/sold), feature (annonce sponsorisée + star), toggle status (Active→Inactive), and delete all functional.

issues: Property cards have no photo placeholder image when no base64 uploaded — just a faint building icon on light grey. Acceptable but a more polished placeholder would help. Currency formatting (EUR fr-FR) renders correctly: '285 000 €'.
When listing has no photo, large grey hero area takes ~250px with only a thin icon — consider tighter layout for media-less listings.
Filter chip labels admin side are in French ('Toutes/Active/Inactive/Vendu/Loué') while data-testids use English suffixes — fine for testing, but be aware re-admin-filter-sold maps to label 'Vendu'.

critical_code_review_comments: Inquiry phone field accepts any string (no E.164 validation client-side). Backend accepts +33611112222. Consider client-side phone format hint.
MyPropertiesPage 'Marquer vendu/loué' button label is contextual but the toast text 'Statut mis à jour' is generic — could specify 'Annonce marquée vendue/louée' for better UX feedback.
Delete uses browser confirm() dialog (handled via page.on('dialog')). Consider a styled modal for consistency with the rest of the app.

Backend rejects self-inquiry with 400 (correct). Frontend does NOT hide the 'Faire une offre' button for the listing owner — clicking would show a backend 400 error toast. Either hide the contact bar or short-circuit client-side when listing.user_id === current user id.
Successful inquiry toast 'Votre demande a été envoyée au propriétaire !' is good. Modal closes properly.

To test inquiry, must use a different account than the listing owner (backend returns 400 on self-inquiry). The frontend does NOT hide 'Faire une offre' for owners — flagged as minor UX issue. rca of the issue: No bugs. All 8 frontend scenarios pass. One UX improvement candidate: hide 'Faire une offre' / contact modal when current user is the listing owner (backend already prevents self-inquiry with 400).
